_doc: The three environments (docs/PLAYBOOK.md Phase 6 item 9). Read by gamelab.env and tools/env_link.py, tools/deploy.py. <install> = the Steam install of app 619820, <repo> = this repo, <cloud> = Steam userdata/<account>/619820/remote.

isolation.detail: A GameLab game dir: copies of HWR2.exe and its DLLs (sha256-checked against the install every preflight) with res/ junctioned to the install. HWR2 reads HWR2.exe.cfg, writes HWR2.exe.log and keeps local saves (saves/) next to the exe it was started from, and g_save_slot_cloud 0 keeps it off Steam Remote Storage. The game resolves %LOCALAPPDATA% (its save_backups/) through SHGetKnownFolderPath, so the exe starts suspended and tools/bin/hwr2_capture.dll is injected before its first instruction; the shim answers FOLDERID_LocalAppData with GAMELAB_LOCALAPPDATA = <game_dir>/appdata.
isolation.verify: live process image (QueryFullProcessImageNameW) is <game_dir>/HWR2.exe; the shim log shows SHGetKnownFolderPath hooked; HWR2.exe.log 'Launch options: 1: <exe>' names the GameLab exe; the user's real saves/config hash unchanged after the run

links.detail: a real directory, never a junction (the game writes res/controls.cfg): files >= 8 MB hard-linked (os.path.samefile), smaller files sha256-verified copies, subdirectories junctioned
